query: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM password_item_entities WHERE team_id=$1) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM password_write_intents WHERE team_id=$1) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM password_folders WHERE team_id=$1) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM password_totp_enrollments WHERE team_id=$1) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM password_team_lifecycle WHERE team_id=$1) OR (SELECT id FROM password_import_activity WHERE team_id=$1 ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) IS NOT NULL AS "present!"
